ownership.production: backend; no edits by this test change
ownership.integration: manager and backend; new combined head required

tests.parameterizedScenarios: Multiple cases per function; function count is not a run/pass count.

wiringRequired.status: Not applied. Backend owns production manifest and private module connection.
wiringRequired.privateAccess: Tests compile as a child module of production storage, not a copied implementation. No public test hooks or production exports needed.

oracles: Roundtrip through existing zip reader with known CRC 0xcbf43926 for ASCII 123456789 and CRC 0 for empty files.

Inspect only newly generated normal ZIP structures: local/central CRC and lengths, no ZIP64 sentinels/extra fields, expected count and final footer adjacency. No malformed EOCD fixture or old blocked reproduction.
Compare stored and deflated order/name/content/CRC/method/fixed DOS time. Same Rust output used to calculate small exact budgets; never compare full C# ZIP bytes.
Private sink tests inspect bytes, position and capacity before/after failed writes; force first errors without real allocator failure.
For each successful trace checkpoint, separately inject Cancelled or Deadline, require Err and no later callbacks. Covers Input, patch Write/Seek, Finish and Return actually observed by that trace.

csharpEvidence.mapping: hello.txt bytes [7,8,9], processed/output/entry failure cases; copied intent only, original unchanged.
ASCII case duplicate and ancestor conflicts. Linux-only allowed names/backslash behavior deliberately not claimed as parity.
ASCII reserved stems, component length, controls, trailing dot/space; Unicode excluded.

observations: Private storage checks input + maximum logical extent before reserve/resize. Rewrites do not double charge.
Gate first failure is sticky; pre-existing gate failure blocks later callbacks and storage writes/seeks/flushes.
Owned inputs are moved and then dropped; no recovery/zeroization guarantee.

Upstream ZipWriter::finish consumes writer and may implicitly finalize again before backend-only failure is returned. stderr and all backend cleanup work are not suppressed; existing contract discloses this limitation.
staticReview.conclusion: Static source review and regression sources only. No dynamic correctness or vulnerability-free claim.

validation.rustfmt: Installed 1.99.1 rustfmt format and check completed. Default stable shim initially lacked rustfmt; no installation or toolchain settings changed.
runLimitations: 42 public tests and 11 private tests are not yet wired or executed.

Callback Deadline tests prove injected stop behavior only. Private expired-Instant test initializes an already expired deadline and preexisting sink state; it is not an elapsed-wait or concurrent timing test.
Allocation and Engine wrapping checks are type-mapping tests, not actual allocator/OOM or codec failure reproductions.
No hard CPU/heap/preemption, worker/process/filesystem/IPC/UI, Windows execution, full C# parity or product acceptance validation.

centralRules: Verify exact integrated head and all files first. Require discovery of 42 public and 11 private tests; zero tests is not a pass. Report each run and fixed head separately. Stop on mismatched source or unexpected targets.
preserved: No existing source, fixture, expectation, lock, PR28-34 head, security reproduction or execveat action changed. No download/install/build/test execution/VM/user archive/merge/C# deletion.
